title: Number of Ways to Form a Target String Given a Dictionary
description: Calculate the number of ways to form target string using characters from given dictionary at specific indices.
pseudocode:
1. count[char][index] = frequency of char at index in dictionary
2. dp[i][j] = ways to form target[i:] using columns [j:]
3. if j == m: return 0
4. ways = dp[i][j+1] (skip current column)
5. ways += count[target[i]][j] * dp[i+1][j+1] (use current column)
6. return ways

Initializing DP table with target length 3 and dictionary length 3
Matching 'a' at column 0, multiply count by sub-problem
